title: Не убеждает — ещё не опровергнуто
description: Не убеждает — ещё не опровергнуто: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Точно передавать позицию I remain unconvinced
Отделять недостаточную поддержку от доказанной противоположности
notes: I remain unconvinced сообщает, что приведённые доводы не убедили говорящего.
Фраза сама по себе не утверждает доказанного опровержения; основания и позицию нужно читать дальше.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: “I remain unconvinced by this explanation” alone establishes which position?

options.label: The explanation has not persuaded the speaker.
The opposite explanation has been conclusively proved.
The speaker has not read anything.

exercises.editorial_answer: The explanation has not persuaded the speaker.
exercises.explanation: Фраза сообщает о неубеждённости, а не о доказанном противоположном выводе.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: refute / refutation.

public_payload.sentence: A challenge to the support is not automatically a ___ of the claim.

exercises.editorial_answer: A challenge to the support is not automatically a refutation of the claim.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Отказ согласиться сам по себе не устанавливает противоположное утверждение.»
exercises.editorial_answer: Withholding assent does not by itself establish the opposite claim.
exercises.explanation: Позиция относительно доводов и доказательство альтернативы различаются.

exercises.prompt: Что именно рецензентка поставила под сомнение?

public_payload.passage: After reading an account of why the community display had attracted fewer visitors, a reviewer wrote that she remained unconvinced by its explanation. The account blamed the revised opening time, but offered no comparison with other events and did not discuss the road closure outside the building. A headline described her response as proof that opening times had no effect. She rejected that description too. Her objection concerned the adequacy of the account’s support; she had not established that the proposed factor was irrelevant. She requested a clearer comparison and consideration of the alternative explanation. Those requests left open the possibility that timing mattered, that the road closure mattered, or that both contributed. Reporting her stance accurately required preserving the difference between declining assent and demonstrating a contrary conclusion.

options.label: The existence of the community display.
The possibility of any future comparison.
The adequacy of the support for the explanation.

exercises.editorial_answer: The adequacy of the support for the explanation.
exercises.explanation: Она оценила достаточность доводов, не отрицала событие или возможность проверки.

exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: unconvinced — неубеждённый; refute — опровергать; threshold — порог; assent — согласие с утверждением.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Does “unconvinced” necessarily mean that an alternative is proved?

options.label: Yes; every reservation proves the opposite.
Yes; asking for comparison settles causation.
No; it states that the offered case has not persuaded the speaker.

exercises.editorial_answer: No; it states that the offered case has not persuaded the speaker.
exercises.explanation: Недостаточная убедительность и доказанное опровержение не тождественны.
